* Music School Workload Management System

** 1.0 Project Planning and Requirements Analysis
*** 1.1 Project Scope Definition
**** 1.1.1 Review music school project description.
**** 1.1.2 Identify project objectives and scope.
**** 1.1.3 Identify stakeholders and their responsibilities.
**** 1.1.4 Analyse existing workload allocation processes.

*** 1.2 Stakeholder Engagement
**** 1.2.1 Prepare stakeholder interview questions.
**** 1.2.2 Conduct stakeholder interviews.
**** 1.2.3 Conduct focus group discussions.
**** 1.2.4 Prepare and distribute questionnaire.
**** 1.2.5 Consolidate stakeholder findings.

*** 1.3 Requirements Development
**** 1.3.1 Identify functional requirements.
**** 1.3.2 Identify non-functional requirements.
**** 1.3.3 Define business rules and assumptions.
**** 1.3.4 Review and resolve requirement inconsistencies.


** 2.0 System Requirements Modelling
*** 2.1 Use Case Analysis
**** 2.1.1 Identify system actors and use cases.
**** 2.1.2 Develop formal use case specifications.
**** 2.1.3 Develop UML use case diagram.
**** 2.1.4 Verify use cases against functional requirements.

*** 2.2 Workflow Analysis
**** 2.2.1 Identify key music school workflows.
**** 2.2.2 Develop activity diagrams.
**** 2.2.3 Review activity flows and decision points.

*** 2.3 Object-Oriented Analysis
**** 2.3.1 Identify Boundary, Control and Entity classes.
**** 2.3.2 Define class attributes and operations.
**** 2.3.3 Establish class relationships.
**** 2.3.4 Develop UML class diagram.
**** 2.3.5 Review class diagram consistency.

*** 2.4 System Interaction Analysis
**** 2.4.1 Identify interactions from formal use cases.
**** 2.4.2 Develop sequence diagrams for UC-01 to UC-06.
**** 2.4.3 Develop sequence diagrams for UC-07 to UC-12.
**** 2.4.4 Develop sequence diagrams for UC-13 to UC-18.
**** 2.4.5 Develop sequence diagrams for UC-19 to UC-22.
**** 2.4.6 Validate sequence diagrams against use cases and classes.


** 3.0 Milestone 1 Consolidation and Submission
*** 3.1 Report Preparation
**** 3.1.1 Compile requirements documentation.
**** 3.1.2 Compile use case specifications and diagrams.
**** 3.1.3 Compile object-oriented analysis documentation.
**** 3.1.4 Prepare stakeholder evidence and appendices.

*** 3.2 Quality Review
**** 3.2.1 Verify requirements and use case alignment.
**** 3.2.2 Review UML diagram consistency.
**** 3.2.3 Address identified issues.

*** 3.3 Milestone 1 Delivery
**** 3.3.1 Prepare presentation slides.
**** 3.3.2 Finalise and submit M1 package.


** 4.0 Software Architecture and Detailed Design
*** 4.1 Design Refinement
**** 4.1.1 Review Milestone 1 feedback.
**** 4.1.2 Update system requirements and use cases where necessary.
**** 4.1.3 Refine and finalise UML class diagram.

*** 4.2 Component Diagram
**** 4.2.1 Identify system components.
**** 4.2.2 Define component responsibilities.
**** 4.2.3 Define component interfaces and dependencies.
**** 4.2.4 Develop UML component diagram.
**** 4.2.5 Review component diagram against system requirements.

*** 4.3 Architectural Pattern Selection
**** 4.3.1 Evaluate suitable architectural patterns.
**** 4.3.2 Select architectural pattern.
**** 4.3.3 Develop supporting architecture diagram.
**** 4.3.4 Document architectural rationale.

*** 4.4 Design Pattern Application
**** 4.4.1 Identify relevant system design problem.
**** 4.4.2 Select one suitable design pattern.
**** 4.4.3 Develop supporting class diagram excerpt.
**** 4.4.4 Explain design pattern application and benefits.


** 5.0 User Experience and Prototype Development
*** 5.1 Interface Planning
**** 5.1.1 Identify screens required for each user role.
**** 5.1.2 Plan navigation between system functions.
**** 5.1.3 Establish consistent interface layout.

*** 5.2 Staff Management Prototype
**** 5.2.1 Design staff availability submission interface.
**** 5.2.2 Design job preferences interface.
**** 5.2.3 Design personal schedule and workload dashboard.
**** 5.2.4 Design job rejection interface.
**** 5.2.5 Design leave/MC submission interface.

*** 5.3 Manager Scheduling Prototype
**** 5.3.1 Design manager workload dashboard.
**** 5.3.2 Design staff availability and comparison interface.
**** 5.3.3 Design weekly job allocation interface.
**** 5.3.4 Design student lesson request and waitlist interface.
**** 5.3.5 Design job reassignment interface.
**** 5.3.6 Design late availability review interface.

*** 5.4 IT Administrator Prototype
**** 5.4.1 Design user account management interface.
**** 5.4.2 Design role and teaching qualification management interface.

*** 5.5 Prototype Integration
**** 5.5.1 Assemble prototype screens.
**** 5.5.2 Connect prototype navigation where applicable.
**** 5.5.3 Map screens to corresponding use cases.
**** 5.5.4 Review prototype against functional requirements.
**** 5.5.5 Prepare screenshots and descriptions.


** 6.0 Testing Design
*** 6.1 Black-Box Test Design
**** 6.1.1 Select suitable function for testing.
**** 6.1.2 Identify test conditions and expected behaviour.
**** 6.1.3 Develop complete decision table.
**** 6.1.4 Reduce decision table where applicable.
**** 6.1.5 Derive test cases from decision table.
**** 6.1.6 Verify test case traceability.

*** 6.2 White-Box Test Design
**** 6.2.1 Select suitable method for testing.
**** 6.2.2 Develop method pseudocode.
**** 6.2.3 Construct Control Flow Graph.
**** 6.2.4 Calculate cyclomatic complexity.
**** 6.2.5 Identify independent paths.
**** 6.2.6 Develop white-box test cases.


** 7.0 Final Project Integration and Delivery
*** 7.1 Milestone 2 Report
**** 7.1.1 Document updates from M1.
**** 7.1.2 Compile final class and component diagrams.
**** 7.1.3 Compile architectural and design pattern documentation.
**** 7.1.4 Compile black-box and white-box testing documentation.
**** 7.1.5 Compile prototype screenshots and descriptions.

*** 7.2 Final Quality Assurance
**** 7.2.1 Cross-check requirements, use cases and diagrams.
**** 7.2.2 Verify testing documentation consistency.
**** 7.2.3 Review prototype completeness.
**** 7.2.4 Conduct final internal review.

*** 7.3 Project Submission
**** 7.3.1 Prepare final presentation slides.
**** 7.3.2 Prepare prototype demonstration.
**** 7.3.3 Rehearse presentation.
**** 7.3.4 Finalise and submit M2 package.

@endwbs
